bundle.shortDescription: Design test reports; render PDFs offline from LabVIEW and any language.
bundle.longDescription: Report Builder designs data-driven test reports and renders them to PDF with an embedded typesetting engine: no browser, no network. Test stations render the same templates with report-cli or the reportbuilder library for LabVIEW, Python and C#, available as separate downloads.
